title: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1

entities.name: Quintorius Kand
entities.description: A young loxodon planeswalker and researcher who arrives on Ixalan to help translate tablets and is tracing the long-dead Coin Empire across planes.

entities.name: Wayta
entities.description: A young warrior of the Sun Empire with a metal disk over one eye who saves Quint from dinosaurs and guides him to Orazca.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A planeswalker and the Sun Empire's warrior-poet, partner of Saheeli, who translates the tablets and opens the golden door.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: A planeswalker and legendary artificer, Huatli's partner, who is building fire-breathing dinosaur constructs for the emperor.

entities.name: Inti
entities.description: Huatli's cousin, a dinosaur rider, seneschal of the sun and hero of the war against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Pantlaza
entities.description: A large dinosaur, tame to Huatli, that obeys Wayta's command and behaves like an eager puppy.

entities.name: Caparocti
entities.description: The Imperial champion, summoned by Huatli's guard to join the expedition.

entities.name: Malcolm
entities.description: A siren, Downtown's official emissary and a shareholder in the mine, who investigates why Downtown has gone silent.

entities.name: Breeches
entities.description: A blue-furred goblin in a three-cornered hat who accompanies Malcolm to Downtown.

entities.name: Captain Vance
entities.description: A Brazen Coalition captain who orders Malcolm to investigate Downtown.

entities.name: Xavier Sal
entities.description: The mayor of Downtown, who signed a hurried note asking for help.

entities.name: Lank
entities.description: A Downtown miner found dead on the road, his body overgrown with mushrooms and black veins.

entities.name: Governor Brass
entities.description: The governor whose edicts the Dire Keel fleet chafes against.

entities.name: Amalia
entities.description: A vampire cartographer of the Queen's Bay Company who is haunted by a voice and visions of a golden door.

entities.name: Clavileño
entities.description: A fanged, cold-eyed commander of the soldiers protecting the expedition, loyal to Vito.

entities.name: Bartolomé del Presidio
entities.description: A kindly vampire high officer of the Queen's Bay Company who objects to Vito's blood rite but does not stop it.

entities.name: Vito Quijano de Pasamonte
entities.description: A moody, menacing vampire who leads the expedition and carries Venerable Tarrian's journal and lance.

entities.name: Venerable Tarrian
entities.description: A figure from the Church of Dusk's past who traveled with Saint Elenda; his suppressed journal guides Vito.

entities.name: Saint Elenda
entities.description: A saint said to have emerged from a golden door like the one in the temple.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: The vampire god, creator of the first vampires, said to slumber behind a door in his temple.

entities.name: Chimil
entities.description: A god imprisoned for centuries according to the tablets' poem; Huatli wonders if she is the Sun Empire's Threefold Sun.

entities.name: Zacama
entities.description: A dinosaur larger than any other Huatli knows.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The jungle plane of dinosaurs, golden cities and warring empires where the story takes place.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: A golden city with a central temple-pyramid, battered by war, where Huatli and Saheeli work on the tablets.

entities.name: Sunray Bay
entities.description: A Brazen Coalition settlement whose economy depends on deliveries from the Downtown mine.

entities.name: Downtown
entities.description: A mining camp with a surface outpost and an underground village around an ancient cenote mine, found abandoned.

entities.name: Temple of Aclazotz
entities.description: A ruined jungle temple with a cenote, catacombs and a golden door sealed by blood magic.

entities.name: Queen's Bay Company
entities.description: The company that employs Amalia as a cartographer and Bartolomé as an officer.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The empire of Orazca's people, led by an emperor impatient to open the golden door.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: A coalition whose economy depends on the Downtown mine.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: A faction that raids to stop the earthquakes and runoff caused by the mines.

entities.name: Dire Keel
entities.description: A fleet that chafes against Governor Brass's edicts.

entities.name: Dusk Legion
entities.description: Vampires from Torrezon trying to gain a foothold on Ixalan.

entities.name: Church of Dusk
entities.description: The vampire church threatened by a growing schism.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders against whom Inti is a war hero.

entities.name: Coin Empire
entities.description: Quint's name for a long-dead civilization he tracks across the planes; its coins appear on the tablets.

entities.name: Komon
entities.description: The people who wrote the tablets' poem and fought the Great Betrayer.

events.summary: Quint planeswalks to Ixalan.
events.quote: As Quint planeswalked from a dimly lit stone corridor into leaf-dappled sunshine, the heat slapped him like a moist towel.

events.summary: Three dinosaurs corner Quint in the jungle.
events.quote: He looked up and found himself dangerously close to an open mouth full of curved pointy teeth.

events.summary: Wayta calls off the dinosaurs, rescuing Quint, and introduces herself.
events.quote: With the flick of a hand, she dismissed the others as if they were trained pets, and they disappeared into the jungle.

events.summary: Wayta leads Quint to a view of the golden city of Orazca.
events.quote: saw the full, blinding brilliance of the golden city in the valley below

events.summary: Quint meets Saheeli and Huatli in a chamber of tablets and a huge golden door.
events.quote: This is my partner, Huatli.

events.summary: Huatli explains that the translated glyphs suggest the door leads to the birthplace of humanity and home of the gods.
events.quote: I believe they're the key to opening this.

events.summary: Inti arrives and is introduced as Huatli's cousin and a hero of the war against the Phyrexians.
events.quote: Seneschal of the sun, dinosaur rider, hero of the war against the Phyrexians.

events.summary: Inti relays that the emperor is growing impatient and wants the door opened by other means; Huatli asks for more time.
events.quote: The emperor grows more impatient

events.summary: Saheeli reveals the emperor is keenly interested in her fire-breathing constructs, and Huatli confesses she fears more war.
events.quote: I made the mistake of wondering aloud if I could make them breathe fire.

events.summary: Malcolm examines a fungus-ridden corpse near Sunray Bay.
events.quote: The body slumped in a pile of half-rotted leaves in the jungle, close enough to Sunray Bay that Malcolm could have walked instead of flying.

events.summary: Malcolm identifies the dead man as Lank, a Downtown miner.
events.quote: I think this is Lank

events.summary: The note found on Lank, signed by mayor Xavier Sal, reveals Downtown is under attack.
events.quote: Downtown under attack , it read.

events.summary: Amalia has a vision of sand, fire and a golden door, and a voice calls her; Clavileño wakes her before she falls from her saddle.
events.quote: Amalia bolted upright in her saddle, her arm aching as if she'd been pushed.

events.summary: Amalia notes the expedition's goal of finding a Temple of Aclazotz and a door that may end the Church of Dusk's schism.
events.quote: A Temple of Aclazotz supposedly awaited them in the depths of this continent.

events.summary: Huatli finishes translating the tablets' poem about the Komon and the imprisoned god Chimil.
events.quote: The translation was finished.

events.summary: Huatli realizes the door's glyphs match the tablets symbolically and slots them in correctly; the golden door cracks open.
events.quote: A whisper of magic touched her fingers, and the space around each tablet glowed softly.

events.summary: Beyond the door, Huatli's party finds glowing, linen-wrapped warrior corpses and the armored remains of a massive horned creature.
events.quote: The remains of a massive humanoid creature dominated the opposite corner of the room

events.summary: Huatli orders word sent to Inti and Caparocti that the expedition leaves as soon as the pack dinosaurs are ready.
events.quote: Tell them we leave as soon as the pack dinosaurs are ready.

events.summary: Huatli tells Saheeli the way is open and they will part soon.
events.quote: I need to take my fill of you before we part.

events.summary: Malcolm and his companions find Downtown completely empty and abandoned.
events.quote: The lamps were dark, and as far as Malcolm could tell, Downtown was entirely empty

events.summary: Malcolm finds the word DOWN painted in ichor beside the one lowered elevator and sends a companion back to Sunray Bay.
events.quote: One word, the letters thick and blocky.

events.summary: Vito shows the expedition Tarrian's lance and journal.
events.quote: was wielded by Venerable Tarrian, in whose footsteps we follow.

events.summary: Vito announces the door leads to the resting place of Aclazotz and promises to return him to Torrezon.
events.quote: is a door that leads to the resting place of our ancient god and sire, Aclazotz, creator of the first vampires.

events.summary: The expedition reaches a golden door in the catacombs, but Amalia sees it is not the door from her visions.
events.quote: To Amalia's surprise, this was not the door in her visions.

events.summary: Bartolomé protests that Vito corrupts the blood rites, but backs down.
events.quote: You corrupt the sacred blood rites

events.summary: Vito sacrifices a porter on the obsidian altar.
events.quote: With a single swipe, Vito cut the victim's throat.

events.summary: The sacrifice opens the golden door and Vito praises Aclazotz.
events.quote: The door groaned open.

relations.quote: A fine sentiment for the empire's warrior-poet, eh?

relations.note: hero of the war against them
relations.quote: hero of the war against the Phyrexians
"Get a torch," she told Wayta, who quickly complied.
I had hoped Pantlaza would be less energetic after some exercise outdoors

relations.quote: Captain Vance had already ordered Malcolm
